svg.title: Six UMAP layouts of the same data at the same number of neighbours, differing only in the random seed, drawn as six small pictures on one shared scale. Each is labelled with how much of the local neighbourhood survived and how well the distances between far-apart points survived.
svg.text: six seeds. same data, same neighbours.
who is near whom moved by 0.02 across these six. how far apart things look moved by 0.15.
near = how much of each point's own neighbourhood survived. far = how well the distances between far-apart points survived. both run 0 to 1.
